subject: Fix unexpected vk-search flag in RDB after dropped all indexs (#785)
reason: The fix only changes DoesGlobalMetadataContainEntry in src/coordinator/metadata_manager.cc, reached solely through MetadataManager::GetSectionsCount and SaveMetadata, the RDB aux-section callbacks of the coordinator's global-metadata manager.
